questions.question: Seven friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Raj is second to the left of Sachin. Dinu is between Krip and Veer. Dinu is second to the right of Sachin. Raj is fourth to the right of Veer. Rocky is second to the right of Sam. Who is second to the left of Veer?
questions.solution:
Seven friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Raj is second to the left of Sachin and Dinu is second to the right of Sachin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8563348f98cb5f873db5380f043a31e7b8c3bcd67c82f624ef7ae73b052b0264.png] 

2) Raj is fourth to the right of Veer and Dinu is between Krip and Veer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15ffe35ba8be6170e6683313e4c12292b565db337839e48084bdf240a4fc5de.png] 

3) Rocky is second to the right of Sam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e681ef5076ff8ad1ae295a35333cc96c2498f15f7fc20639b09eb373d177382.png] 

∴ Here, 'Rocky' is second to the left of Veer.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rocky".**

questions.question: Eight friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a round table at an equal distance between each other, facing the centre of the table. D is sitting between F and H. A is not sitting between B and G. C is sitting third to the right of A. E is sitting second to the left of D. Who is sitting opposite to A?
questions.solution:
Eight persons facing centre: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) D is sitting between F and H.

2) E is sitting second to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4641e3a4d7cae99f3e18ef0a4bbcee2d894af2f708115c22280ffe27cde3355d.png] 

3) C is sitting third to the right of A.

4) A is not sitting between B and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215eaedbc82a60d2b22e0c0a022c8536338bfe05aded1ae6bc032f2ce41eeb93.png] 

Final sitting arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b13e7538af0bb982c9d152dd8f315d25e4768b62b5407d77d1df99410611e2e.png] 

Hence, “E” is sitting opposite A.

questions.question: Seven persons, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting along a round table facing outward. C is sitting 2nd to the left of A but to the immediate right of D. B is 3rd to the right of A while G and E are sitting between them. What is the sitting location of F?
questions.solution: Seven Persons are sitting: A, B, C, D, E, F, G. **Facing direction:** Away from center. 1 ) C sits second to the left of A. 2) C sits to the immediate right of D.

questions.question: Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sitting clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence, facing the centre, at equal distances between them. If U is facing the north-east direction, then who is facing the south direction?
questions.solution:
Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sit
ting clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence, facing the centre, at equal distances between them.

1) If U is facing the north-east direction

2) Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are sitting clockwise around a circular table in the **same sequence** facing the centre.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**

questions.question:
Pranavi, Vinita, Rupa, Soumya, Bhavana, Urmila and Arohi are seven friends sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle. Arohi is second to the left of Soumya and is the neighbour of Bhavana and Urmila. Soumya is not a neighbour of Rupa or Bhavana. Pranavi is a neighbour of Vinita and Rupa.

Based on the given information, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Arohi is sitting between Rupa and Pranavi.
Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi.
Vinita is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi.
Soumya is sitting between Urmila and Arohi.

questions.solution:
**Pranavi, Vinita, Rupa, Soumya, Bhavana, Urmila and Arohi** are seven friends sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle.

1. Arohi is second to the left of Soumya and is the neighbour of Bhavana and Urmila.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3358d9c1e4691a2043790612584de1834f29e8c3b48af8fa124f45b544a29f51.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b63540b6f1a6588c0cae902a7d6e1bbd6401d9f9dbc70323862c81b7096b86b8.png] 

2. Soumya is not a neighbour of Rupa or Bhavana.

Case II is eliminated based on the above statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11b76b3fdc7278ee1dd438cb0d01b8cc096a57aa82225b45d8bb75450b4ffb1e.png] 

3. Pranavi is a neighbour of Vinita and Rupa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d18ab1fde57c46c76792a673895460adcff71d3fd7f40af77be14a0381f8e3f.png] 

Based on the given information, the statement which is correct is: 

 
• Arohi is sitting between Rupa and Pranavi. → False
 
• Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi. → True
 
• Vinita is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi. → False
 
• Soumya is sitting between Urmila and Arohi. → False

Hence, '**Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: There are eight friends, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, sitting around a circular table facing the centre but not necessarily in the same order. F, is the immediate neighbour of D. C is second to the right of A. There are only two persons between A and D. E and G are immediate neighbours, while H and F are also immediate neighbours. B is third to the left of F. D is third to the left of G. How many persons are sitting between B and G, when counted in clockwise direction from B?
questions.solution:
There are eight friends, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, sitting around a circular table facing the centre but not necessarily in the same order. 

1) D is third to the left of G and there are only two persons between A and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4101c4a95ccf0a896c1f0e4c636ddcbb0c2810e5eaa3f5873f3926b80ea4bf7c.png] 

2) F, is the immediate neighbour of D and C is second to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad8a9fe20eff0dc74733cfc7b53d963ee789c4f7b402244acefb32ccadf8778f.png] 

3) B is third to the left of F and E and G are immediate neighbours, while H and F are also immediate neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3993fca0bd605fdef98218206048dc988b4fbdca249eff032a09f874fcb60f1.png] 

∴ Here, there are 'Two' persons sitting between B and G in clockwise direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Two".**

questions.question: Eight friends, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting at two circular tables, one smaller inner table and one bigger outer table. Both the circular tables have the same centre. Four persons are sitting at each table at equal distances between them, facing the centre. M is to the immediate right of L. Q and N are sitting in the south and are facing R and L. M is sitting opposite to O at the same table. P is sitting opposite K at the outer table. N is between P and K at the same table. L is between M and O at the same table. Who is sitting in the north at the outer table?
questions.solution:
Eight friends, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting at two circular tables, one smaller inner table and one bigger outer table. Both the circular tables have the same centre. Four persons are sitting at each table at equal distances between them, facing the centre.

1) **N is between P and K at the same table** and Q and N are sitting in the south and are facing R and L and **P is sitting opposite K at the outer table**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bad8c24929db6e3ee9ecff258a1a19bc481b91ca92ea11b2f737473d232fbcf2.png] 

2) M is to the immediate right of L and L is between M and O at the same table and Q and N are sitting in the south and are facing R and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c42e0bbcd4dc02ac7e88a252ec15dee34552d7b260537f2620dee9d4d6e6b82.png] 

∴ Here, 'R' is sitting in north at outer table.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**

questions.question: Seven friends, Subhi, Prince, Ketan, Vishal, Mahima, Krish and Naitik, are sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre. Subhi is sitting to the immediate right of Prince. Naitik and Krish are not sitting to the immediate left or right of Vishal. Vishal is sitting third to the left of Prince. Mahima is sitting to the immediate right of Vishal. Who is sitting third to the right of Prince?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven friends sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre this means they are facing outside the centre: Subhi, Prince, Ketan, Vishal, Mahima, Krish and Naitik,

1) Subhi is sitting to the immediate right of Prince.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81faf7897aef5cf9b738c1d7e9b600f835fe416173e61e0a9b47a3e2336d8e4f.png] 

2) Vishal is sitting third to the left of Prince.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circle facing at the center. E, is second to the left of F and third to the right of A. B is third to the right of G who is not an immediate neighbor of E or F. C is second to the right of B. D is to the immediate left of A and third to the left of H. Who is the fifth to the right of C?
questions.solution:
Given eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circle facing the centre.

1) E, is second to the left of F and third to the right of A.(E is second to the left of F. E is third to the right of A.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7c2573841412e93814eac94c3905a8b539cf3aeac2e28a348eff379fb9e47d.png] 

2) B is third to the right of G who is not an immediate neighbour of E or F. (G is not neighbour of E or F)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0726f2876fa55c5fb6e47fb31ee02bc8d6ede00908a6929ea8dd392bc0222303.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9fb7f40c14a9bd0972b58a09f945db68902cdc8fd542f279c67dd43f68bdc5.png] 

3) C is second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ebcec0fdf8e71836bfc013c9b22816d8b7ba518015646ca61faf1d8cf3a81d8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99e5a4e1d5fb8f575c9654ca37d61806af2b81826e4d21c65752ac12b26b7e19.png] 

4) D is to the immediate left of A and third, to the left of H. (By this condition, we can eliminate case II therefore) 

The final arrangement is.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d605604c921025edec78830e0c2fa9463809a921aec3fdc3eea102ddf022c9e.png] 

Hence, E sits fifth to the right of C
